reviews.comment: Dr. Campbell is very passionate about her class! Her class is made up of half essays and half attendance quizzes which are based off readings. She assigns so many readings and the quizzes sometimes ask for specific details from it. For a cultural discourse class, I think the workload was heavy. But Dr. Campbell herself is a great lecturer!

reviews.comment: Dr. Campbell is honestly one of the better professors I have had. Yeah, the course is not easy but if you put in the work you will do well in her class. She is such a sweet person and if you ask for help she will give 125% to help you succeed in her class. Dr. Campbell really wants participation in class so do the reading before class.

reviews.comment: The professor herself is very passionate about the course, however lacks to understand that not all students will feel the same. She is also a tough grader, who demands too much.

reviews.comment: Even though Dr. Campbell's class was challenging (hard exams, lots of reading, participation in class expected), she is honestly one of my favorite profs.
